title: ApiKeyUpdate
description: Body of PATCH /api-keys/{keyId}; any of name, project_id, enabled; an empty body is a 200 no-op (still needs api_keys.rotate or api_keys.revoke). Absent = unchanged; none of these fields is nullable. name/project_id need permission api_keys.rotate, enabled needs api_keys.revoke. Unknown keys are a 422.

project_id.description: Move the key to another project of this workspace.

enabled.description: Absent = true on create, unchanged on update or replace. Boolean only: null is a 422.

id.description: Response field (read-only). Absent or null on create; on update it may be echoed back only with its current value — anything else is a 422 immutable_field.
